title: Replace bam_aux_get with pure Rust tag search
description: Replace bam_aux_get FFI call (~22 lines, linear search through auxiliary data) with pure Rust byte-slice scanning. This is a high-value leaf: it unlocks all 4 bam_aux_update_* functions (bam_aux_update_int, bam_aux_update_float, bam_aux_update_str, bam_aux_update_array). Used in src/bam/record.rs. Complexity: easy.
